attack_patterns.description: Threat actors exfiltrate large volumes of sensitive data to cloud storage or their own servers before encryption as part of a double extortion tactic.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups frequently gain initial access by using compromised credentials purchased on the dark web or obtained through phishing.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 5e8b1b9e-9b7c-4f1a-a8f3-a6d3c1c0d7e5
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/24/check-point-ransomware-attacks-q3-2026-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-24
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity, though rare for deleting all shadows quietly.
level: high
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery, as noted in the report's Cyber Observables section.
